additional_relied_on_properties.assessment: An explicit threat-model exclusion is not a probe-established premise; exact membership, bootstraps and all credential routes still need evidence. Root trust does not waive frame-caused reads/writes under V5-B02.
additional_relied_on_properties.probes_or_evidence: P-LAUNCH, CRED, P-SEAL, P-SETUP, P-SR plus installed source/seal review
additional_relied_on_properties.reliance: Root/kernel/exact unchanged writer and launcher trusted base; only authorized setup confers roles

additional_relied_on_properties.assessment: A descriptor digest or opaque message is not sender authentication, complete delivery or producer authority. C3 needs launcher-rl-identity bytes/digest delivery; implicit imports, loaders and mutable providers are part of closure.
additional_relied_on_properties.probes_or_evidence: P-PROTO, P-RUNTIME, P-LAUNCH, P-READ and exact producer/consumer source review
additional_relied_on_properties.reliance: Channel confinement, descriptor identity, module/provider closure and authenticity of observations

additional_relied_on_properties.assessment: Close-marker linkage has a coherent structural commit point. Post-link fsync outcomes are not in the marker itself; the missing writer-death observation case cannot inherit a definite synced boolean.
additional_relied_on_properties.probes_or_evidence: P-COMMIT, P-CHAIN; writer-death-before-error-announcement controls and every live/reboot/offline consumer
additional_relied_on_properties.reliance: Journal primitive, common chain reader, fallback and per-record sync/error truth

additional_relied_on_properties.assessment: Finite synthetic states do not prove exhaustive effects. Script-local cleanup of prior atoms, proper-prefix files and image allocation/format effects are missing; runtime-grown rollback is not the reversal of setup-only state.
additional_relied_on_properties.probes_or_evidence: P-SETUP, P-SR, installed exact global atom table, raw partial-effect records
additional_relied_on_properties.reliance: Global setup/reconciliation/rollback exact state enumeration including ordinary and service effects

additional_relied_on_properties.assessment: Controls are specified and future. Signal relay and kernel-empty observation must not erase the original ownership/window/manager checks or turn release into a record-durability gate.
additional_relied_on_properties.probes_or_evidence: P-SIG, P-RELAY, P-STREAM, P-TERM and exact role/state-machine review
additional_relied_on_properties.reliance: Signals, sudo relay, true holder terminal/stream finality, reservation and original approval boundaries

additional_relied_on_properties.assessment: Allowance identities are arithmetic only. No missing peak is discharged by samples, write-limit refusal or command-count scope; original proof and accepted-case requirements remain open.
additional_relied_on_properties.probes_or_evidence: P-ENOSPC, IMG, exact inventories, original complete retained outputs/temporaries/restore bounds and proof receipts

No premise was probed here and no universal premise was established.

premises.assessment: Namespace ownership, maps and process placement are measurable; no user manager or runtime directory ever exists is a closed-entry-route property under the declared root trust, not an inference from one selftest.
premises.required_discharge: Pin namespace creation/ownership and every permitted entry/credential route; verify version-matched semantics and lifecycle/drift records without adding a new approval gate.

premises.assessment: Owner presentation, stored ids and successful owner O_NOATIME use can be measured. Unmapped ids and non-idmapped/pseudo filesystem effects must be accounted for; this is not evidence that host-uid substitution preserves the domain.
premises.required_discharge: Version-matched idmapped-mount argument and exact map/mount pins, syscall controls and complete original ownership/ACL domain correspondence.

premises.assessment: The installed header describes MAKE_SOCK as creating, renaming or linking a socket, and REFER still requires matching per-type rights and no access gain. Granting REFER everywhere does not leave every same-mount rename/link unchanged. A sample of directory pairs cannot establish that universal assertion.
premises.required_discharge: Correct the predicate, retain all originally accepted rename/link cases, and redesign the rules or architecture wherever their behavior changes; then review exact installed LSM paths and real socket/directory/control cases.

premises.assessment: Cross-vfsmount link/rename restrictions do not make EXDEV precede every permission check. Path-component search permission can fail earlier. The exact mounts, operands, flags and failure order must be stated for each row.
premises.required_discharge: Replace the universal errno ordering with precise path-resolution and operation predicates, preserving genuine accepted controls and custody; no relaxation to accept arbitrary wrong-operand denials.

premises.assessment: Private propagation is a plausible conditional mechanism. One host-mount sample is not proof that the entire cloned/masked view and all subsequent namespace changes have the stated propagation relation.
premises.required_discharge: Specify the complete mount construction including process root/cwd, private flags and nested namespaces; source-grounded installed-version review and immediate exact mount-table evidence.

premises.assessment: The expanded row covers read and write access modes and pre-first-call windows, but root cannot succeed on every operation and operand type. A3 belongs to another RL-created root-owned user namespace, so commoncap is an additional possible denial; that row cannot attribute its failure solely to Landlock.
premises.required_discharge: Use type-, access-mode- and address-valid positive controls for each API; distinguish same-user-namespace cross-domain controls from cross-namespace controls and review every hook. Retain the original Yama/descendant and pre-entry controls.

premises.assessment: Initial-namespace absence of capability and nested-user-namespace handle restrictions are relevant; exact filesystem/mount ownership, locked children and relaxed directory-handle paths still require installed-source review and positive operand controls.
premises.required_discharge: Pin the exact file-handle path, capabilities and mount roots, including directory/relaxed cases; validate sacrificial controls without reading or handling a live admitted entry in this review.

premises.assessment: The observed cgroup documentation supports populated as live member processes including descendants. Migration controls and worker placement are separate premises; no task escape needs a complete root-only entry/migration argument, not only failed writes in one fixture.
premises.required_discharge: Version-matched cgroup/clone/migration/worker analysis, exact delegated permissions and membership evidence throughout the attempt, with all former members and their children covered.

premises.assessment: No R or GATE process after a selftest is an end-state sample. Only RL confers these ids must follow from all credential, PAM/sudo, service, file capability and namespace routes within the trusted-base boundary.
premises.required_discharge: Closed entry-route/code/installation correspondence plus continuous attempt evidence and drift handling; no circular assumption that the very launcher being assessed is the only route merely because it says so.

premises.assessment: The recorded-period AIO/io_uring exercise is correctly refutation only. Populated zero is not, by itself, a universal theorem that all file descriptions or queued/registered/kernel-held logical mutations have ended. Physical writeback and later logical metadata/data changes need distinct predicates.
premises.required_discharge: Complete version-matched task-exit, file-reference, filesystem, AIO/io_uring and other admitted asynchronous path argument, or a redesigned holder boundary; a finite quiet period is never universal closure.

premises.assessment: Successful O_NOATIME opens suppress access-time changes for those opens under owner/capability rules. Direct controlled reads are only part of bootstrap/module/dynamic-loader and helper reads; the original R-d/R-f/R-h obligations remain open and R-c implicit reads require classification.
premises.required_discharge: Audit every explicit and implicit causal read and directory traversal against the original authority boundary. Preserve readable foreign-owner accepted cases; neither failure nor target-residual relabeling discharges them.

premises.assessment: Nosuid/set-ID/file-capability behavior is conditionally plausible. Mount-flag locking, all mounts including recreated/pseudo mounts, nested namespaces and all target privilege routes need source and construction evidence.
premises.required_discharge: Exact mount/flag/capability/credential lifecycle correspondence and original-domain privilege behavior analysis, with genuine set-ID/capability controls.

premises.assessment: Landlock filesystem topology restrictions and less-privileged mount locking are relevant. They do not substitute for proof that actual fs_struct root/cwd and retained path descriptions are in the constructed view.
premises.required_discharge: Close process-root/cwd/old-root-description construction and version-matched nested/move/unmount/bind restrictions, then use independent root/cwd and ancestor-path observations.

premises.assessment: N7 labels the probe as first engineering run, while section 13 correctly denies that any finite run establishes a universal premise. The phrase must mean a baseline comparison/refutation for that run only; otherwise installed-evidence qualification relies on an unqualified run.
premises.probe: first engineering run; P-RUNTIME per attempt
premises.required_discharge: Complete baseline-field relation under original accepted cases and version-pinned identity/runtime closure. Treat each run comparison only as evidence for that run; do not promote it into a universal preservation fact or new approval gate.

premises.assessment: Scope manager ActiveState and kernel populated are independent sampled observations updated at different times. systemd handles an empty-cgroup event to enter the dead state, so equality at every moment is not a kernel or manager invariant.
premises.required_discharge: Specify conservative, race-aware manager/kernel conjunction and the full original terminal/release predicate. Keep the original ownership, process, manager and window controls; neither observation alone grants release.

premises.assessment: The proposal properly denies durable-under-allocation-failure claims before a sacrificial verification. Extent/allocation/fsync and torn-slot assumptions are installed-filesystem properties, not exact arithmetic conclusions.
premises.required_discharge: Installed-version/filesystem extent and failure argument plus full fallback/raw/crash controls under unchanged reserve and success rules.

premises.assessment: The static directory/root pin specification is repaired and closed locally. Source, setup, exact mounted identities, usable geometry and capacity are still future evidence; image write limits do not establish successful capacity.
premises.required_discharge: Exact measured mount/image identities and geometry, entry-set readbacks, all setup/partial/reversal states and full retained-output/restore peak capacity without lowering accepted cases.

premises.assessment: This can be a precisely defined source-level target-tool sub-lemma. It does not by itself cover the full frame/preparation/evidence/backup domain, or implicit loader/credential/resource/timing effects; command names are not the complete original success domain.
premises.probe: source-grounded toolchain review; engineering runs refute only
premises.required_discharge: Complete source-to-binary/helper/environment/configuration/native closure and full-domain observable refinement; redesign every changed accepted case, without restricting the quantifier or carving out result-affecting timing/cost.

premises.assessment: The new tmpfiles rule is behaviorally compared to the original /tmp rule, and has a probe. It is absent from N7 and section 18.6 remaining-premises list. A finite back-dated-file test cannot establish all cleanup age, ownership, open-reference, path, mount and concurrency behavior.
premises.required_discharge: Add this reliance to the premise/dependency register and preserve original cleanup semantics and causal mutation authority through exact rule/code and full accepted-domain analysis.

premises.assessment: The export restore exercise omits raw torn/uncommitted record and marker bytes and native outputs that remain only in protected originals. Digests/indices do not make those bytes independently recoverable or verifiable.
premises.required_discharge: Restore and independently re-read every required original/equivalent evidence byte and retained native output under the existing operator-controlled vault workflow and full capacity bound.

withdrawal_assessment: Removing probes solely for mechanisms actually removed is legitimate; it does not remove the original positive/negative/accepted-case/failure controls that the successor mechanism must satisfy.
